description: This file defines the EmployeeAPI class which handles REST API endpoints related to employee management in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, listing, creating, and deleting employee records, along with validation rules and associated models.

classes.name: EmployeeAPI
classes.description: Defines REST API endpoints for CRUD operations on Employee entities, including retrieval, listing, creation, and deletion, with validation and model handling.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific employee by employee number, returning either a default or detailed model based on request parameters.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Fetches a list of employees based on filtering, sorting, and pagination parameters, with access control.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new employee record, including optional profile picture upload, with role-based authorization.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Not implemented; intended for updating employee records.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes employee records given a list of employee numbers, checking for proper permissions and undeletable status.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving a single employee.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing employees with filters and sorting.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a new employee, including field constraints and uniqueness checks.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Not implemented; intended for validating update requests.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules to ensure only accessible and valid employee IDs are deleted.
